en: Fixed the Claude apps gateway answering `431 Request Header Fields Too Large` to every request from a sign-in whose identity provider lists many groups; it now accepts request headers up to 256 KiB
zh: 修复了当登录所用身份提供方列出大量群组时，Claude 应用网关对每个请求都返回 `431 Request Header Fields Too Large` 的问题；现在可接受最大 256 KiB 的请求头
